newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PdVSA sees Venezuela 1997 inflation at 37 pct.
newsitem.headline: PdVSA sees Venezuela 1997 inflation at 37 pct.

text.p: Venezuelan state-owned oil company PdVSA expects 1997 inflation to reach 37 percent, compared to the government's official 25 percent target, Finance Ministry sources said.
"The inflation figures they (PdVSA) are officially using is 37 percent," said the source.
PdVSA president Luis Giusti discussed the figure, one of the key variables in PdVSA's 1997 budget, on Friday with Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar.

PdVSA also estimates an average exchange rate of 520-522 bolivars per dollar for 1997. The government has meanwhile used a 490 bolivars per dollar estimate for next year's average exchange rate as the base for next year's government budget.
